Template and copy changes need her sign-off before merge.","criticality":0.5,"epistemic":"fact","id":"01a107ee-818d-7072-9208-6aae5cf8f7a0","invalidated_at":"2026-10-04T17:20:37.468645096Z","logical":["notifier"],"physical":["services/notifier/"],"provenance":"human","status":"challenged","summary":"Who owns the notifier","superseded_by":"01a107ee-8faf-7c31-b897-a769aa72edab","tags":["notifier","ownership"],"type":"context","visibility":"shared"}}

The Growth team has to sign off. Any Growth engineer can approve, and the sign-off happens in **#growth-eng**.

This comes from the project's memory notes, not from anything in the repo. I found no CODEOWNERS file. As of 2026-09-01 the notifier belongs to Growth, because Dana Okafor moved to Platform. An older note still named Dana as the sign-off, so I flagged it as outdated.

Two other conventions apply to a wording change:
- **Template files:** the receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Edit its plain-text twin `<event>.txt` to match, because some mail gateways strip HTML.
- **Variables:** keep variable names snake_case.
